claims: Jennie Baranczyk is the head coach of the Oklahoma Sooners women's basketball team.
Jennie Baranczyk has held the position of head coach of the Oklahoma Sooners women's basketball team since April 2021.
Jennie Baranczyk has led the Oklahoma Sooners women's basketball team to four consecutive NCAA Tournaments.
The Oklahoma Sooners women's basketball team made consecutive Sweet 16 appearances in 2025 and 2026.
Jennie Baranczyk won two conference championships.
Jennie Baranczyk was named the ninth head coach in the Oklahoma Sooners women's basketball program history on April 10, 2021.
Jennie Baranczyk is in her fifth season (2025–26).
Jennie Baranczyk spent nine seasons as the head coach at Drake before joining Oklahoma.
Jennie Baranczyk had a 192–96 record as head coach at Drake.
Jennie Baranczyk played collegiately at Iowa.
